entries.title: Psalms 124:1
segments: A Song of degrees; of David. Except that [it was] the LORD who was for us, O may Israel say;

entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: Except that [it was] the LORD who was for us when men rose up against us,

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

entries.title: Psalms 124:4
segments: then the waters would have flowed over us, the stream would have gone over our soul;

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

entries.title: Psalms 124:6
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD, who has not given us [as] a prey to their teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; the snare is broken, and we have escaped.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Our help [is] in the name of the LORD, who made the heavens and earth.
